entries.final_answer: Recursive checker in Java
entries.question: How is the closed-response-objects convention enforced after five review rounds found holes in the Spectral rule?
entries.rationale: Operator ruling 2026-10-18. Spectral's JSONPath rules cannot classify composed schemas (allOf/anyOf/oneOf, tuples, boolean schemas, constraint-only members) recursively; five review rounds each found a new hole. The closure convention moves to a small, unit-tested Java checker in the :contracts project that walks the bundled contract with a positive recursive classification and runs in check. The Spectral rule closed-response-objects is removed from contracts/lint/ruleset.yaml.
